c74object.name: evi_rampsmooth
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Reimplementation of MSP rampsmooth~ in gen abstraction form
c74object.description:
evi_rampsmooth is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_rampsmooth is identical to MSP rampsmooth~ providing exact ramps in the given destination times. The algorithm is slightly different to account for efficiency in the gen~ domain, but it seems to work well. Based on the gen~ example by Maurizio Giri and Graham Wakefield.

geninlet.name: input
geninlet.digest: Value. Input value to be smoothly ramped.

geninlet.name: ramp
geninlet.digest: Up in SAMPLES @min 0. Amount of time the value takes to reach it's up destination. evi_rampsmooth reaches it's up destination exactly in this time.

geninlet.name: ramp
geninlet.digest: Down in SAMPLES @min 0. Amount of time the value takes to reach it's down destination. evi_rampsmooth reaches it's down destination exactly in this time.
